sentence: The NHS groups antidepressants into types such as SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclics and MAOIs, and lists mirtazapine as a noradrenaline and specific serotonergic antidepressant (NaSSA). Mirtazapine is the NaSSA covered on this site.

sentence: Pharmacology reviews describe mirtazapine as blocking alpha-2 receptors on nerve cells in the brain, which increases the release of noradrenaline and serotonin, and as also blocking 5-HT2 and 5-HT3 serotonin receptors. Unlike many other antidepressants, it is described as not inhibiting the reuptake of noradrenaline or serotonin. Blocking histamine H1 receptors is linked to its sedating effect.
